files = state["uploaded_file"] or payload
info = extract_products_from_payload(files)
state["products_all"] = info["products"]
opts = {str(i): product_label(p, i) for i, p in enumerate(info["products"])}
state["product_options"] = json.dumps(opts)
state["products_found"] = len(info["products"]) > 1
state["selected_product"] = "0" if info["products"] else ""
state["pdp_copy_markdown"] = ""

n_p, n_ok, n_bad = len(info["products"]), len(info["files_ok"]), len(info["files_failed"])
if n_p == 0:
    state["status_message"] = "Couldn't read any products from the uploaded file(s) — please upload .xlsx product information documents."
else:
    msg = f"Found {n_p} product{'s' if n_p != 1 else ''} in {n_ok} file{'s' if n_ok != 1 else ''}."
    if n_p > 1:
        msg += " Pick which one to write copy for, then generate."
    if n_bad:
        msg += f" Skipped {n_bad} unreadable file{'s' if n_bad != 1 else ''}: " + ", ".join(info["files_failed"]) + "."
    state["status_message"] = msg
